tool_args.rationale: Fit all four parameters of the archived barrier-activated siphon numerically. The five observations span both input and sink gradient, so the specified gradient-discrimination probe is not indicated before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient span is 2.0, well above the archive's 0.08 threshold for this mechanism.
Barrier activation and the archived barrier-modulated siphon directly match the pilot signatures; confirmation will test that choice.
The observed signatures support the static barrier law rather than the coupled memory ODE.
